text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest`. This session has no command-execution tool, so nothing has been run. Please run it to confirm.

- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, matching the lending policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`**: the fee used `days_late + DAILY_FEE`. It now multiplies, so 4 days late costs 1.00.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books()` was missing "Emma". I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copies for Emma are my choice, since the tests only check the title.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of a `[-n - 1:]` slice. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` left `year` as a string. It now converts it to an int, which the year and age tests need.

I read every test file and checked each fix against what its test expects.
